--- Page 4 --- Dedicated to my affcctionate father RANGAM G MOMIN First Edition--1978 Copyright Reserved --- Page 5 --- Twis book belong to Go JANAPcHENGANI Onkala classrango poraigiparangna mangsonge A'chikku- chi segimin poraigni ka'taprang da'omangde aditan ong kataha, indiba school ba collegeni chukala gadango poraina segimin kitaprangde namcn komikucnga.
Indaka miksonganiosa ia kitapko anga seaha.
Ia cliongipa kitapko mongsongbate ming gittam ja'pang kattarango pangchake anga seaba :-- 1.
An'tangtangni gimin u'ie-ra'ani ; 2.
Sakgipinrangoniko namako skie-ra'ani ; aro 3.
Nama janggi tanggnina an'tangtangko tarisoani.
Anchingni poraibaginin ki'taprango a'gilsakni dingtang ra'baaha, indiba ua ki'taprango jattangni manderangni, a'song- janapanisan dongaia ba janapanian dongsrangja.

Changa-sapbatgipa aro skia-man'batgipa gipin a'songrangni aro manderangni kamrangko uie-ra'ania uamangni kamrangko ja'rikpana anchingna dakchaka, indiba an'tangtangni gimin name uichengania ua kamrangko chu'sokbate aro mangrakbate ja'rikna an'chingna dakchaka.
An'chingni ma'gitcham pagit- chamrangni gitcham dakbewal aro niamrangko bang'batakon see rakkirika dongjani ginin uarang da'o ka'sine ka'sine gimaroroangengaha.
A'chik jatni daka-rikatang kamrangkon ma'sijani gimin an'ching sakantian kratcha'ana bate duk man'nasa krabata.

Uarangkoba poraigni bak dake ra'gatode, an'ching sakantiko gisik ra'attaipilna dakchakasan ong'jawa, indiba uarangoni mitam ba bangakon an'chingni skia-man'a ia chasongo dingtang bimango ra'gate jakkaltogipa ong'atna man'naba dongachim.
--- Page 6 --- (i) Mandeni janggi tanganio uko ong'siatgipa, duk aro sikkim- anio ga'akatgipa Ja'pang a'sela uni ong'sia kam-cholon, namgijagipa bewalrang, an'tangko u'inikani, aro aratani ong'a.

Ong'siao ba duko ga'akna skang mikrakatsoani ba champengsoani maiba kattarangko mesoke on'ania indaka kamrango ga'akgnioniko mandeko chelchakatsona dakchaka; ong'siao ba duko ga'akmane janggi tangenggipa manderangna aljokatani cholrangko mesoke on'aniba, uandaken, nambata aro krabata janggi tanganiona an'pilbaatna uamangko dak- chaka ; pangnajolna changchipgija ba u'ichipgija sichipangana batede tangengmitingo dal'a kratcha'aniko man'emangba manderangoniko je on'tisako skie-ra'anian baditaba chang nambata !
Beben, mandeni skie- aro ma'sie-ra'na nanggni kamrang inditan apala aro raka, jotton ka'bebegenchimoba mande uarangko skie- aro ma'sie-ra'tokna amjawacbim.
Pa Wilnan A Sangmako uni Nokma Jaksil Gana aro angni pagipa, Rangam G Mominko uni Tangbangani aro Maina Beng'a ?
ingipaaseanirangko ia ki'tapo gatna cholko on'anina mittelbea.
Shillong, Meghalaya, DONALD N.

A'chikrang Goalpara aro Mymensinghni a'kawerangona re'angrongbataha.
